svg.title: Ten AWS changes between November 2025 and January 2027
svg.desc: Vertical timeline with a line marking today, 2026-10-24. Already happened: 2025-11-07 Snowball, Migration Hub and Application Discovery Service close to new customers; 2025-12-02 new Support plans, and Developer and Business Support take no new customers; 2026-04-30 AWS Audit Manager closes to new accounts; 2026-05-20 Amazon Inspector Classic shuts down; 2026-07-30 Amazon Kendra closes to new customers; 2026-09-16 AWS announces a new sign-up experience; by 2026-09-27 the exam guide is revised, still CLF-C02. Announced, still to come: 2026-10-29 WorkSpaces Secure Browser closes to new customers; 2026-12-31 Snowball support ends, and the Italian and German exams retire after this day; 2027-01-01 the Developer, Business and Enterprise On-Ramp Support plans end.
svg.text: Ten changes a learner would meet in about fourteen months
Selected AWS renames, closures and plan changes, Nov 2025 to Jan 2027 (checked 2026-10-23)
